last_review_summary: R59, his own framing of the working contract: 'I give you a goal, and you'll give me a deliverable.' Two hard rules follow. (1) INCIDENTAL WORK RUNS SILENTLY: technical debt, prerequisites and self-inflicted fixes must not consume his attention or his turns - do them without narrating each step, or defer them. He should be interrupted only for a decision only he can make. (2) HIS TIME IS THE SCARC…
